name: Aknadinine
summary: ). Structurally it is a member of the hasubanan family of alkaloids and features an isoquinoline substructure.

fact.en: It belongs to the hasubanan alkaloids, a family found in plants of the moonseed family. Their ring skeleton looks strikingly like that of morphine, which has made them of interest to opioid chemists.
fact.zh: 它屬於哈蘇巴南（hasubanan）生物鹼，這類化合物存在於防己科植物中。它們的環狀骨架與嗎啡驚人地相似，因此吸引了鴉片類藥物化學家的注意。
fact.zhHans: 它属于哈苏巴南（hasubanan）生物碱，这类化合物存在于防己科植物中。它们的环状骨架与吗啡惊人地相似，因此吸引了鸦片类药物化学家的注意。
